Keep selected import-mode and outline-button labels readable (#1017)
Preserve contrast for persistent checked/active/show states and unchecked radio hover. Extend the existing special-modes acceptance with computed/composited color evidence and an actual checked-but-unfocused screenshot.
Verified unchanged head c23212ee with complete CI 33956933922, exact-head approval-recommended review (3/3 files, zero findings), PostgreSQL/Oracle/SQL Server, Security, Kubernetes, document E2E and push CodeQL 33956186088. Inspected actual CI screenshot from artifact 9966841324; all 18 live color readings pass and independently recompute. No certification beyond the tested states is claimed.
Fixes #1015. Refs #964.
